requirements.quote: Add packages/notifications/src/channels/whatsapp.ts (provider client, approved templates, send only to the verified linked number, per-user consent, quiet hours, court-hours rules)
extend the `notification.deliver` job (DELIVERY_CHANNELS) and the evening court-day summary (digest.end_of_day), court.board and status.order alerts to use it
Unit test: no message is ever sent to a number other than the verified user's.
Residency and processor review of the provider is a human action tracked with #488.
requirements.why: Human action tracked by open issue #488; not code. The channel stays disabled until provider env is configured.

deliverables.change: New createWhatsAppSender (Meta Cloud API via injectable fetch; absent env -> undefined), template registry keyed by category (court.board, status.order, digest.end_of_day), content-minimal params, send(message, target) where target is an explicit {e164} resolved by the caller; no function accepts a free number from notification data; permanent (4xx) vs retryable error classification; E.164 re-check before send. Plus channels/index.ts and a ./whatsapp export in packages/notifications/package.json.
Add the './whatsapp' subpath export to src/channels/index.ts (no new dependency).
DeliveryJob.channel includes 'whatsapp'; notify() fan-out includes whatsapp when the resolved pref is enabled+instant (opt-in only: do not add whatsapp to any defaultChannels).

DELIVERY_CHANNELS adds 'whatsapp'; deps gain optional whatsapp sender built from env; branch: channelEnabled, target via getWhatsAppSendTarget (from '@causedeck/core/whatsapp-link' index, null -> skip 'not_linked'), no sender -> skip 'whatsapp_disabled', courtHoursQuiet -> skip 'quiet_hours', send inside once(); only the resolved target is used; permanent provider error -> failed, other -> RetryableError. digest.end_of_day stays skipped here (own send).

After the digest is built, when the member's digest.end_of_day whatsapp pref is on and getWhatsAppSendTarget(category 'digest.end_of_day') returns a target and the local time is outside court hours, send the evening summary template (counts only, no matter names) inside the existing once().
Re-export any new public types if needed (DELIVERY_CHANNELS already exported).
Add WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID and WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN (secret) to serverKeys and the zod schema, optional, each requiredWhen the other is set (mirror VAPID_*); optional WHATSAPP_API_VERSION.
Document the WHATSAPP_* keys (commented), as done for VAPID.
Document the WHATSAPP_* keys (the env doc guard test may compare it with the schema).
Document the WhatsApp channel: templates, opt-in, target rule, quiet/court hours, skipped reasons.
Add 'whatsapp-link' to the jobs allow-list (index import only).
Add jobs --> whatsapp-link edge and mention in the jobs row.

Unit tests: sends only to the explicit target; refuses a non-E.164 target; absent env -> no sender; permanent vs retryable errors; template per category; a spy fetch never sees any number except the target.

Tests: whatsapp sends only to the verified number of the notification's owner (two users, one linked: the other's notification sends nothing; another workspace's link ignored); unlinked, category not chosen, pref off, quiet hours, sender absent -> skipped; retry/permanent behaviour.
Test the evening WhatsApp summary: sent to the verified number, not in court hours, not when unlinked or pref off.
Update expectations for the whatsapp fan-out / DeliveryJob if they assert channels.

preserve.what: Email and push delivery behaviour and skip reasons in packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/notification-deliver.ts (existing tests stay green).
getWhatsAppSendTarget in packages/core/src/whatsapp-link/link.ts stays the only source of a destination; do not change its signature.
No whatsapp in any CATEGORIES defaultChannels (packages/notifications/src/categories.ts): opt-in only (D-029 consent).
@causedeck/notifications must not import @causedeck/core (core depends on notifications); the target is passed in.

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/notifications exec vitest run src/channels src/index.test.ts src/push --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}

decisions.choice: Channel takes an already-resolved target from the caller (the job) rather than looking it up
decisions.justification: core depends on notifications, so notifications cannot import core/whatsapp-link (packages/config/eslint/core-domains.js); getWhatsAppSendTarget (link.ts:295) is the sole destination source per D-029

decisions.choice: Mirror the push sender: env-built, absent config disables and records a skip
decisions.justification: notification-deliver.ts:105-117 and push 'push_disabled' skip; keeps the channel inert until #488 residency review completes

decisions.choice: Court-hours rule reuses notification_setting.courtHoursQuiet + isQuietTime for alerts, and the evening summary is never sent inside 10:30-17:00
Add 'whatsapp-link' to the jobs domain allow-list
decisions.justification: jobs must call getWhatsAppSendTarget; domain imports go through index.ts (CLAUDE.md registry table)
